title: Agent 3D (Python) system design
summary: The standalone Python worker claims one durable edit job at a time and owns everything CAD-specific: goal creation, semantic planning, the Agent3D tool-calling loop against an isolated candidate, validation, hash-guarded commit, mandatory reindex, and best-effort export.

nodes.label: Edit Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres edit_jobs is the only durable handoff; there is no nested tool-call queue between Nest and this worker.

details.responsibility: Own queued/running/completed/failed edit jobs, worker lease, private history checkpoints, and ordered public events.

nodes.label: Agent 3D Worker
nodes.description: A polling Python process; every replica has a unique CAD_EDITOR_WORKER_ID and claims one job at a time with a heartbeat-renewed lease.

details.responsibility: Coordinate goal creation, planning, the Agent3D loop, and the post-loop commit pipeline for exactly one claimed job.

operations.concurrency: One claimed job per replica; horizontal scale adds parallelism across parts/projects, not within one job.

guarantees: A linked part_id is reserved on the queued row before any model call, so a second overlapping request fails fast with PART_EDIT_IN_PROGRESS.

nodes.label: Goal + High-level Plan
nodes.description: A strict CadGoalDefinition is created from the request, then PlanningAgent produces a version-1 CadPlan using two read-only semantic-index tools.

details.responsibility: Turn a free-text request into an authoritative goal and a step-sequenced plan before any source is touched.
steps: goal_creator.py returns required-vs-preserve criteria; an ambiguous request ends the job with CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED.
PlanningAgent may use at most 8 read-tool rounds against index_search / index_get_feature.
The resulting CadPlan's steps must collectively address every goal criterion.
guarantees: Both the goal and the plan are checkpointed to edit_jobs.history before planning ends, so a reclaimed worker skips duplicate LLM calls.

nodes.label: Candidate Storage
nodes.description: 3dProjects candidate prefixes hold an edit-scoped copy of source plus a pre-edit original backup, fully isolated from canonical source.

details.responsibility: Give the reasoning loop a mutation target that canonical source is never exposed to while the loop runs.

nodes.label: Agent3D Reasoning Loop
nodes.description: The plan-driven loop: one Agent3D.decide() call per turn, its tool calls executed against the candidate, bounded by per-step and overall turn caps.

details.responsibility: Advance the plan one step at a time until every step is completed, or fail fast on a turn-limit or no-action decision.

failureConditions.condition: A decision requests no tool call
failureConditions.outcome: AGENT_NO_ACTION — fails fast rather than assuming completion.

failureConditions.condition: A single step exceeds 10 turns, or the job exceeds 24 turns total

nodes.label: CAD Validator
nodes.description: The independent validator executes the exact final candidate, identified by path and SHA-256, and returns structured pass/fail proof.

details.responsibility: Prove the candidate is syntactically and semantically valid before canonical source can ever be touched.
guarantees: A validation failure fails the job outright (VALIDATION_FAILED) — there is no repair loop that feeds diagnostics back to Agent3D.

nodes.label: Canonical CAD Source
nodes.description: Accepted model.py and params.json — written only after passed validation and a hash-guarded read-verify-write-reverify.

details.responsibility: Own accepted CAD source; commit is rejected as SOURCE_CHANGED if canonical no longer matches the accepted base hash.

nodes.label: Indexer Worker
nodes.description: A mandatory post-commit reindex proves the just-committed source still produces a fresh semantic index.

details.responsibility: Reindex committed source; a failure rolls canonical source back to its pre-edit backup and fails the job (REINDEX_FAILED).

nodes.label: CAD Exporter
nodes.description: Best-effort export queued only after commit and reindex both succeed.

details.responsibility: Render the committed source; an enqueue failure adds a warning to the terminal result instead of failing the job.

edges.label: bootstrap edit-scoped candidate from accepted source

details.summary: Runs once, before the first agent turn; a resumed job reuses the existing candidate untouched.

edges.label: run the plan-driven loop until every step is completed

details.summary: Read-verify-write-reverify against accepted_source_sha256; idempotent no-op if canonical already equals the candidate hash.

details.failureBehavior: An enqueue failure becomes a terminal-result warning; it never rolls back the commit.

boundaries.label: Agent 3D (single Python process)
boundaries.description: Everything from claiming the job through the reasoning loop and hash-guarded commit runs in one worker process, with no nested tool-call queue.
